override.rule: A lock, the baseline commit or the sprint changes only through scripts/project-state.py, with --by and --reason. Moving baseline.commit while the baseline is locked, or changing the sprint while the sprint is locked, needs --override and is recorded as such. The resulting file change is a commit; hard rule 1 makes every commit a human approval, and the commit prompt names every lock, baseline and override change in it.
commands: scripts/project-state.py set-sprint --id N --integration-branch B --by WHO --reason WHY [--override]
